# FrameCapture

One frame a [BenchmarkConfig](BenchmarkConfig.md) saves as an image.

## Parameters

- `seconds`: A float. How many seconds after the warm-up the frame is taken. Defaults to `0.0`.
- `path`: A string. Where the PNG is written. A relative path is taken from the working directory the run was started in. Defaults to `""`.
